title: Apply Even-Odd Identities
text: Recall the following properties: tangent is odd, cosine is even, and sine is odd.

title: Rewrite Each Term
text: Apply the identities to each part of the expression: $$cos\left(-x\right)+tan\left(-x\right) sin\left(-x\right)$$ $$=$$ $$cos\left(x\right)+\left(-tan\left(x\right)\right) \left(-sin\left(x\right)\right)$$ $$=$$ $$cos\left(x\right)+tan\left(x\right) sin\left(x\right)$$

title: Express cot(x) in Terms of sin(x) and cos(x)
text: Recall that tan(x) $$=$$ $$\fracsin^c\left(x\right)os\left(x\right)}$$. Substitute this in: $$cos\left(x\right)+\fracsin^c\left(x\right)os\left(x\right)} sin\left(x\right)$$ $$=$$ $$\frac{cos^2\left(x\right)+sin^2\left(x\right)}{ccos^$eft(x\righ$$ $$=$$ $$\frac{1}cos^$\left(x\righ$$ $$=$$ sec(x).
